blocks.title: Sports Desk · Monday beat — closing the Thursday-to-Monday cadence
blocks.dek: Third leg of the trilogy that started with 0411 and 0422. The two-week table has rolled into its second half, the European F1 leg has its first result on the books, and the desk now has a real Thu→Sat→Mon cadence to point at.
